register.title: Create an account
register.name: Name (optional)
register.namePlaceholder: How you'd like to be addressed
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters and at least two character classes (letters, digits, or symbols). Must not contain part of the email or name.
register.successBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. Please click it to activate your account.
register.errorWeak: Password does not meet the requirements
register.errorPasswordShort: Password must be at least 10 characters and combine at least two character classes.
register.pendingBody1: Your account has been created but must first be activated by an administrator. You will not receive an automatic notification — try to log in after approval.
register.pendingBody2: Please also verify your email address once your account has been activated (the verification email has already been sent).

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.intro: Enter your email. We'll send you a reset link (valid for 1 hour).
forgot.sentBody: If an account for {email} exists, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.sentHint: No mail server configured? The link will be printed to the server console.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.passwordHint: At least 10 characters and at least two character classes.
reset.done: Password changed. You can log in now.
reset.errorWeak: Password must be at least 10 characters and combine at least two character classes.

verifyEmail.errorBody: The link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.
verifyEmail.toSettings: Go to settings (request a new link)
